intended_object: The set of "tail pole" indices {3n+1, …, 40n}, i.e. N < j ≤ K with N = 3n and K = 40n. This is an auxiliary index set in a specific irrationality-of-ζ(5) construction, as the docstring and module docs indicate.
explanation: The definition is `Finset.Icc (3n+1) (40n)`. This matches the docstring "N < j ≤ K" once you take N = 3n and K = 40n, the constants fixed by this proof (see `sum_LoC`, which uses a card of 37n). It is a bookkeeping device in the auxiliary construction of the outer-range basis (`tailC`, `rootsO`, …) for one particular proof. It is not a standard mathematical notion, so it has no literature or Mathlib counterpart to compare against.
